value.rationale: A documented 2023 mathematical approximation gap concerns the Frobenius error exponent of Matérn Fourier grids at random sites. The new periodic analogue identifies precisely when that extra spectral exponent is observable in a finite random covariance matrix: the sample count must cross the retained Fourier feature scale. The all-growth-regime concentration, explicit critical constant and exact two-term decomposition make this a practical and structural cutoff-selection diagnostic, beyond a routine fixed-N Parseval calculation.
